# KoreCAD Studio

> **What is KoreCAD Studio?** KoreCAD Studio is a 100% offline native Rust 2D/3D parametric CAD and DXF/STEP manufacturing takeoff-to-quote platform by DH Labs ($19 permanent base pack, $89 MOD_CAM_CNC takeoff & B2B quoting workbench, 18 storefront modules, 8 signed OTA hot-swap bundles, 10 export formats).

## Core Architecture & Key Differentiators

1. **$19 Permanent Base CAD Engine (`BASE_CAD`)**: 5.0 MB native macOS Rust app with 28-entity 2D drafting, 3D solid modeling, direct 3D edge picking partial fillet/chamfer, analytic B-Rep STEP AP214, AutoCAD DWG R2018 (`AC1032`), Direct Vector PDF 1.4, Interactive 3D HTML export, and **free DXF/STEP/STL takeoff analysis** (cutting perimeter, piercing holes, bend lines, volume, mass, and layer-0 color/linetype/lineweight/draw-order grouping).
2. **$89 DXF/STEP B2B Quoting & 5-Axis CAM Workbench (`MOD_CAM_CNC`)**: Persistent custom shop rate card (material KRW/kg, cut KRW/m, pierce KRW/hole, bend fee, machining KRW/hr, quantity discounts, margin, VAT), multi-file batch quoting, 1-click UTF-8 BOM Excel CSV / printable HTML / PDF quotation export, explicit `Class C` rejection of distorted PDF inputs, plus ISO 6983 5-axis RTCP & adaptive trochoidal CAM.
3. **$89 5-Gate Schematization & Scannerless 4-View 3D Reverse Engineering Suite (`MOD_HAND_SKETCH_REDRAW` / `REVERSE_ENG`)**: Deterministic `Class B` 5-Gate Closed-Loop Schematization & Manufacturing Healing Engine (`SCHEMATIZE_GATE`), DIN 6935 sheet metal CNC G-Code (`.nc`), ISO 286-1 `H7/g6` + ISO 1101 GD&T, 4-view photo Visual Hull, 360-degree rotating corner cabinet (`ROTATING_CORNER_CABINET_360`), and Festo Fin-Ray compliant gripper (`FINRAY_COMPLIANT_GRIPPER_CAD`).
4. **Offline NIST FIPS 186-4 ECDSA P-256 Licensing**: 24-hour (3-run) in-app trial and offline asymmetric key (`KORE2-...`) activation with single-step atomic `UNDO`.
5. **Standalone Engineering Blueprint Units (`SKU_Blueprint_1`–`3`)**: Zero-install STEP/DXF/HTML/BOM manufacturing blueprint units ($19 each) distributed via Gumroad (`https://dhlabs.gumroad.com`) and Naver SmartStore (`https://smartstore.naver.com/dhlabs-official`).
6. **Verified Engineering Proof & Refund Policy**: Backed by 715+ automated geometry/physics tests, 39/39 release E2E checks, and a 30-day 100% no-penalty refund guarantee.
